decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY that replaces the USDC refund with an exactOutputSingle swap for exactly 15 USDC and returns unused value as ETH; no additional update or removal is required.
The source changes only the ETH-to-USDC swap path; the direct USDC wallet mint flow remains valid unchanged.
Changing the internal ETH swap method does not alter disclosure or selection of ETH and USDC payment methods.
The Transak fiat conversion and mint path is separate from the connected-wallet ETH exactOutputSingle swap path.
The source does not change when mint-success feedback may be displayed.
The ETH wallet swap implementation does not affect seedless wallet provisioning for fiat buyers.
Obtaining exactly 15 USDC changes payment conversion mechanics but does not alter the established allocation of the 15 USDC mint proceeds.
The source does not change the rule that only successful mint transactions are recorded and counted.
The source changes the base ETH-to-USDC mint conversion and does not remove or modify the independently requested optional tipping interface.
The FAQ's 15 USD price remains correct, and the source does not require disclosure of the internal exactOutputSingle swap implementation.
The landing-page book-cover presentation is unrelated to the ETH swap-method change.
The About page's stated 15 USD mint price and product process remain valid; the source does not require adding internal swap details to this content.
